# hyperbolic-honeycombs: source provenance

Authors: neozhaoliang and contributors; retained isomorphismes fork.

Source: https://github.com/isomorphismes/Hyperbolic-Honeycombs/tree/f2df32b979613dda51584c95ea73e4e51e458257

License: GPL-3.0.

Original Fragmentarium circle-packing and hyperbolic honeycomb raytracing shaders. Include dependencies and the upstream shader host are not copied; these are not standalone GLSL programs.

Each copied upstream file is preserved without editing. See ../sources.tsv for original paths, Git blob identities and sizes. Only selected files are present; dependency closure is not claimed. Execution and numerical acceptance: NOT_RUN.
